{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Display basic info
print(sales.head())
print(sales.info())

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales.isnull().sum()
print("Missing values:")
print(missing_values)

# Check for duplicates
num_duplicates = sales.duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {num_duplicates}")

# Check the unique values in key columns
print("\nUnique values in 'campaign':")
print(sales['campaign'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in 'region':")
print(sales['region'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in 'sales':")
print(sales['sales'].unique())

# Check the distribution of sales
print("\nSales summary:")
print(sales['sales'].describe())"}
